_readme: Fine schedule used by the challan PDF and dashboard. Edit amounts here when the law changes (no code change needed). Choose the region with the FINE_REGION environment variable (sindh or punjab). VERIFY with the official notification before issuing real challans.

sindh.name: Sindh (Karachi)
sindh.source: Sindh Twelfth Schedule, Motor Vehicles Ordinance 1965 s.121-A, as published by Times of Karachi (3 Oct 2025, page updated Jul 2026). Seat belt: Sindh Police e-challan reports.

No Helmet.law: Riding motorcycle without safety helmet (pillion included)

Wrong Way.law: Driving on the wrong side of the road
Wrong Way.note: Wrong way in a one-way street is higher (mc 25,000 / car 30,000 / LTV 50,000 / HTV 100,000).

No Seat Belt.law: Seat belt (not a separate line in the schedule; charged as a general violation)
No Seat Belt.note: Reported e-challan rate for cars: PKR 10,000.

punjab.name: Punjab
punjab.source: Secondary sources on the Punjab 12th Schedule 2025 / Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2025 (caradvisers.com, dailypakistan.com.pk). Less reliable: verify with Punjab Traffic Police.
